posts.title: Futures Pricing
posts.description: In "Arbitrage", we briefly describes part of how futures are priced to argue that futures prices are, in general, not predictive. This post rounds out the discussion and talks about how futures are priced in more detail.

posts.title: July 18th, 2026: Weekend Thinking Cap
posts.description: As the ML/LLM capex boom expands ever larger, a useful exercise is to spend some time thinking about how large this can go, and when or what can potentially derail it. To that end, a post I came across recently puts a lot of things in perspective.

posts.title: May 14th, 2026: Strait of Hormuz
posts.description: The Iran war has been going on for about two and a half months now, and despite the ceasefire, I am getting concerned. Again.
